card.name: First digit of numbers in parentheses
card.fires_on: A single digit that starts or sits inside a number right after an opening parenthesis or decimal point, in results, dose conversions or unit conversions. It is usually the first digit of a percent, a count out of a total, or a converted measure.

modes.label: Percent or count in brackets
modes.description: The first digit of a percentage or a fraction of patients placed in parentheses after a figure.

modes.label: Converted dose or measure
modes.description: A digit in a parenthetical conversion of a dose or distance into other units.

card.plain: It marks a digit in the middle of a number, mostly in brackets after a percentage, a patient count or a converted dose.
